title: Haryana Geography: Landforms, Rivers and Climate: Quiz

questions.question: What is the highest point of Haryana?
questions.rationale: Karoh Peak, about 1,467 m, lies in the Shivalik (Morni) hills of Panchkula district. Dhosi and Tosham are low Aravalli outcrops.

questions.question: Which river forms the eastern boundary of Haryana with Uttar Pradesh?
questions.rationale: The Yamuna is the boundary river and the only perennial one. Ghaggar and Markanda are seasonal.

questions.question: Which of the following is the main seasonal river of Haryana, entering near Pinjore and flowing through Ambala and Sirsa?
questions.rationale: The Ghaggar (Ghaggar-Hakra) is the principal seasonal river. Sahibi, Dohan and Indori are southern Aravalli streams.

questions.question: Which of these rivers is NOT a seasonal stream of Haryana?
questions.rationale: The Yamuna is perennial. The others are rain-fed streams that dry up for much of the year.

questions.question: The Bagar region, a semi-desert tract, is found chiefly in:
questions.rationale: Bagar is the dry sandy northwest. Panchkula and Yamunanagar belong to the Shivalik belt.

questions.question: The northern end of which mountain range appears as scattered low hills in southern Haryana?
questions.rationale: The Aravalli outcrops cover Mahendragarh, Rewari, Gurugram, Nuh and Faridabad.

questions.question: The Ottu barrage is built on which river in Sirsa district?
questions.rationale: Ottu barrage is on the Ghaggar-Hakra at Sirsa. Hathnikund and Tajewala are on the Yamuna.

questions.question: The Western Yamuna Canal takes its water from the Yamuna at headworks in which district?
questions.rationale: The Tajewala/Hathnikund headworks are in Yamunanagar. Karnal, Hisar and Rohtak are served by the canal but are not its source.

questions.question: Which statement about Haryana's rainfall is correct?
options: The southwest gets the most from the sea monsoon
It is uniform across the state
It increases from northeast to southwest
It decreases from northeast to southwest
questions.rationale: The Shivalik belt in the northeast is wettest, while the southwest (Bagar, Mahendragarh) is driest. The state averages only about 590 mm.

questions.question: Which pair of rivers belongs to the southern, Aravalli-fed group that flows toward the Sahibi?
questions.rationale: Dohan, Krishnavati and Indori join the Sahibi system in the south. Markanda, Tangri, Somb and Kaushalya belong to the Ghaggar system in the north.

questions.question: Sultanpur National Park, a bird sanctuary, is in which district?
questions.rationale: Sultanpur National Park is in Gurugram district. Kalesar National Park is the one in Yamunanagar.

questions.question: Which statement about Haryana's natural vegetation is correct?
options: Thorny dry deciduous forest and scrub with shisham, khair and babul is typical
Dense tropical evergreen forest covers most of the state
questions.rationale: Haryana has thorny dry deciduous and scrub vegetation, and very low forest cover compared with India's average.

questions.question: Haryana encloses the National Capital Territory of Delhi on which sides?
questions.rationale: Haryana lies north, west and south of Delhi; Uttar Pradesh lies across the Yamuna on the east.

questions.question: The Bhakra system, Western Yamuna Canal and Sutlej-Yamuna Link are all examples of what kind of irrigation source in Haryana?
questions.rationale: Because most rivers are seasonal, Haryana relies heavily on canals fed from perennial rivers and reservoirs.
